heygen-connector.instructions: DEC-001: never any voice for the Prophet. Voice per character from VOICE_CASTING.md (narration/ensemble: CH-011 voice there). BEFORE calling create_speech, check GENERATION_LOG.csv for an earlier FAILED attempt of the same shot whose error_analysis contains a heygen audio URL for the same text: if so, DOWNLOAD that URL instead of generating again (saves credits). Otherwise call create_speech ONCE per line with the exact text from the prompt file. Download ONLY with ONE standalone command (no &&, no ;, no pipes, no echo): `studio/bin/fetch-media "<audio url>" <output path>` (it creates the folder). Then attempt record with the real cost (credits used x 0.05 USD/s estimate).

google-flow-browser.instructions: Work ONLY in a NEW tab you open yourself on https://flow.google.com/ (the user's own signed-in Chrome). Never read, switch to, or close any other tab. Never change account, plan, billing or settings. Use (or create) the Flow project named after the film ID. Paste the prompt file text exactly; for image-to-video upload the input keyframe. Before pressing generate, read the credit cost Flow shows and STOP with outcome FAILED (failure-category COST_UNKNOWN) if it exceeds the engine price. Wait for completion, download the result and save it to the given output path, then close your tab.

google-flow-mcp.instructions: Use ONLY the mcp__flow__* tools. 1) flow_status; if it returns a hint (not signed in etc.) record outcome FAILED with that hint. 2) Work in the Flow project titled with the film ID (e.g. 'MUTAH-PILOT'): if flow_status shows a different project and flow_assets shows none of this film's assets, call flow_new_project with the film ID once. 3) Call flow_generate with project=<film ID>, ONE scene: the prompt file text (English; Flow has no negative field, so do not paste 'no ...' phrases), type image (keyframes, 16:9) or video (16:9, model 'Omni 1.1 Flash', duration = shot duration rounded UP to 4/6/8/10, resolution 720p, first_frame = absolute path of the input keyframe for image-to-video), variants 1, retries 1, max_credits 12 for video / 0 for images. 4) flow_wait until finished. 5) The file lands in /Users/ahmedabdelrahman/flow-mcp-out/<project>/; convert/copy it to the exact output path (images: `sips -s format png <src> --out <dst>`; video: `cp <src> <dst>`), then `studio/bin/attempt-record ...` with the REAL credits used converted at 0.02 USD/credit (images 0). Never record SUCCESS without the copied file. Run `studio/bin/attempt-record` as ONE standalone command (no `cd`, no `&&`, no pipes) or it is refused. CHARACTER REFERENCES: read the shot's `characters` column in SHOT_LIST.csv and map each CH-xxx to its Flow character via projects/<ID>/media/characters/FLOW_CHARACTERS.json (e.g. CH-001 -> 'asset:Khalid'). Pass up to 3 (principals first) as 'asset:<name>' entries in the scene's reference_images (images and text-to-video only; for image-to-video the keyframe already carries them). If a CH-xxx has no Flow character, fall back to the ABSOLUTE path of projects/<ID>/media/characters/CH-xxx.png. Never create or edit Flow characters yourself.
